items.text: Start with the skill group, then pick the specific tool that matches it today.
The single most requested hard skill in commerce job postings: pivot tables, dashboards, forecasting, and valuation models that turn raw numbers into a decision.
Tally Prime, Zoho Books, and QuickBooks with real GST and TDS knowledge, the practical layer every accounts, audit, and finance-ops role still runs on.

blocks.heading: Questions Before You Pick One Skill Group

items.text: Five skill groups and a six-point scorecard is still a lot to hold in your head. the four questions narrows it down to a fast, practical filter.
Do you focus best alone with a spreadsheet for hours, or do you get energy from talking to people and switching tasks often.
A skill group that fights your natural energy pattern will not survive the first tough exam season.

blocks.heading: Avoid When Building a Commerce Skill Stack

items.text: Five half-finished course certificates look weaker on a resume than one real project you can explain in detail.
Digital marketing performance is measured almost entirely in numbers: cost per click, conversion rate, return on ad spend.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: A combined Tally Prime and GST certificate typically costs between Rs 6,000 and Rs 12,000 and runs for one to three months, covering somewhere around 30 to 90 hours of actual training depending on the depth. Basic Tally-only courses can cost less, in the Rs 4,000-6,000 range, but skip the GST layer that most real job postings now expect by default.

blocks.heading: Group 3: Data Analytics and Power BI

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Commerce graduates who add data analytics on top of their business context have a real edge over generic analytics-only candidates: they already understand what a P&L, a sales funnel, or a cost centre actually means, which shortens the time it takes to turn a dashboard into a business decision. A data analyst role in India realistically ranges from roughly Rs 3.5 LPA for a fresher to Rs 15-30 LPA at senior or lead level, and certified Power BI professionals report earning roughly 10-15% more than non-certified peers doing similar work.

blocks.heading: Degree Still Matters, and Where the Skill

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: CFA fresher pay in India currently runs roughly Rs 6-12 LPA, climbing to Rs 12-25 LPA mid-career and Rs 25-50 LPA or more at senior charterholder level, and CMA-qualified professionals report a similar Rs 7-21 LPA range. These numbers assume you clear a genuinely difficult exam over one to three years. A skill stack does not replace that ceiling, but it gives you real income and real proof of work while you are still working toward it, instead of an empty resume during the years the exam takes.

visuals.heading: Commerce Degree Alone Is Not Enough Anymore

items.text: Just get the degree first, figure out skills after you get a job.
Commerce is a "safe" stream, any B.Com job will do.
Certifications are a waste of money, real learning happens on the job.
Pick CA or MBA and stop worrying about anything else.
A LinkedIn profile that lists the actual thing you built, not just the course name.

One shareable write-up, a single page is enough, of your best piece of work: the Excel model, the mock GST filing, or the Power BI dashboard, with a two-line explanation of the business question it answers.
One visible endorsement from someone who reviewed that work.
1 Right skill mix for you, not the internet's favourite Excel and modelling suit someone who likes sitting with numbers for long, focused stretches.
2 Proof of work over certificates alone A certificate proves attendance.
3 Communication skill sitting on top of the technical skill The best Excel model or GST filing in the world is worth less if you cannot explain it clearly to a manager, client, or interviewer.

4 Market positioning: what role is actually hiring for this combination Before committing months to a skill, check live job postings for the specific role you want, not a vague sense that "this skill is in demand." Business analyst, financial analyst, GST practitioner, and marketing executive job descriptions all list slightly different skill combinations; match your stack to the actual posting, not a generic list.

5 Personal fit with your timeline and family situation A student aiming for CA articleship has very little spare time for a six-month digital marketing deep dive; a student with a lighter course load and no professional exam pending has more room to test two skill groups in parallel.
6 Financial reality: what you can actually spend right now Several of the strongest skills here, digital marketing, basic Excel, and SQL fundamentals, have free or near-free entry points.
